Subject: GCP listing -> procurement & co-sell activation: intake + handoff plan

Hi Samantha / James —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation, Skyline is ready to proceed with the GCP Marketplace listing and wants a clear procurement handoff so finance can raise the PO and legal can sign. Goal: have listing staged and co-sell eligibility submitted to Google by the end of April (timeline flexible if procurement items extend).

Quick summary of asks from Skyline: 
- Clarify SKU / entitlement mapping for commercial billing (they need the spreadsheet to create the PO)
- Confirm DocuSign path for the Marketplace contract and any reseller/co-sell forms
- Identify the internal GCP onboarding contact and estimated staging window
- List any GCP certification/compliance items that will block co-sell submission (e.g., SOC2 attestation copy)

Karthik / Marissa — could you own the procurement mapping + DocuSign bundle? I’ve attached a first-pass manifest and SKU map (draft).

Next steps I propose:
1) Redwood to deliver SKU-entitlement matrix and final manifest (this week) — action: Karthik
2) Skyline to confirm PO contact and expected PO date (by Wed 3/4) — action: Samantha
3) Redwood to package DocuSign + required evidence (SOC2 report, IP addendum) and route to Skyline for signature — action: Marissa
4) Once signed, Redwood to request GCP listing staging window with James and submit co-sell eligibility packet — action: Rishi

Attachments: gcp_listing_manifest_v1.pdf, sku_entitlements_map.xlsx, mutual_action_plan_v2.docx

Appreciate quick confirmation on owners.

— Rishi
Rishi Malhotra

Thanks Rishi — this looks good. A few clarifications from procurement: 

- We need the SKU-level unit price and whether list pricing includes trial credits or promotional tiers (they create PO lines against unit price).
- Our legal team will want to see the final Marketplace contract and any MSA amendments before signing; DocuSign is fine.
- Target PO issuance: week of 3/15, subject to internal approvals. If Redwood can provide the final SKU matrix by 3/5 that gives us time to route the PO.

James — do you need anything on the Google side before staging? If there are co-sell eligibility forms, we can start filling in fields concurrently to save time.

Hi all —

Thanks — attaching an updated SKU entitlement spreadsheet (sku_entitlements_map.xlsx) and a shorter procurement checklist embedded in the MAP doc. Key notes from Redwood side: 
- Each SKU row includes: SKU code (marketplace), short description, unit price (USD), trial allowance (yes/no), billing frequency, and entitlement token name.
- For PO creation, Skyline can reference SKU codes + unit price; we will accept PO with net-30 payment terms unless enterprise billing agreement is requested.
- DocuSign bundle will include: Marketplace Listing Agreement (MLA), MSA addendum for data residency (if requested), and the reseller/co-sell disclosure. Marissa will upload the package to DocuSign by EOD today.

Procurement checklist (high level):
- Redwood provides final SKU matrix (3/5) — owner: Karthik
- Skyline provides PO contact + expected date (3/15) — owner: Samantha
- Legal review window (Skyline) estimated 3-5 business days once DocuSign is received
- Signed MLA returned -> Redwood requests GCP staging window (1-2 week lead time typical)

James: confirming co-sell eligibility packet includes SOC2 snapshot + short product pitch doc. Any additional Google-specific artifacts we should prefill?

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Marketplace Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachment references: sku_entitlements_map.xlsx / mutual_action_plan_v2.docx

Subject: Re: GCP listing -> procurement & co-sell activation: intake + handoff plan

All —

Appreciate the clear plan. Quick items from GCP Marketplace side: 
1) For co-sell eligibility we need: SOC2 attestation date, a 1-page product summary PDF (use the Drive link Rishi shared), and the billing SKU list (CSV preferred).
2) Staging windows this quarter fill up quickly; once the signed MLA is in our system we can lock a 2-week staging slot (best-case).
3) If Skyline expects invoicing to Google Cloud Marketplace (versus direct Redwood billing), let me know — that changes entitlement flow.

Small ask: can Redwood include a single-column 'HubSpot Deal ID' in the SKU sheet (so we can map usage reports back to the HubSpot record)? That will help co-sell tracking.

I’ll provision a staging ticket once Rishi confirms the signed DocuSign envelope ID.

Thanks —
James Lopez
GCP Marketplace Onboarding
Google Cloud
